findings.violation: The autocomplete attribute value should be "email" per HTML specification, not "e-mail".

findings.fix: Add `minlength="8"` to the confirm password input field
findings.violation: The confirm password field lacks the minlength="8" constraint that the primary password field has, allowing mismatched length passwords to be submitted.

findings.evidence: Label states "(8 digits)", placeholder states "Must be 8 digits", but input is `<input id="member-input" name="membership_number" type="text" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="Must be 8 digits" required="">`
findings.fix: Add `minlength="8" maxlength="8"` to the membership number input field
findings.violation: The input lacks minlength and maxlength attributes despite the labels explicitly specifying exactly 8 digits are required.

findings.fix: Change `type="text"` to `type="time"` or replace with a select dropdown containing time options
findings.violation: A contact time field should use an appropriate input type for time selection (type="time") rather than type="text", which accepts any arbitrary text.

findings.evidence: First field: `<input id="name-input" name="full_name" ... autocomplete="name" required="">` and later `<input id="legalname-input" name="legal_name" ... autocomplete="name" required="">`
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate field or clearly differentiate them (e.g., change one to "Legal name" if that distinction is intentional)
findings.location: Name fields (Full name and Your name)
findings.violation: The form asks users to enter their name twice - once as "Full name" and again as "Your name" - with no clear distinction between the two fields.

findings.evidence: `<button id="viewdetails-btn" type="button" style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px">View details</button>` placed mid-form with no surrounding context
findings.fix: Either remove the button, add explanatory text describing what details it reveals, or implement and document the associated JavaScript functionality
findings.violation: This button appears in the middle of the form with no clear purpose, label context, or visible associated functionality to indicate what details would be shown or how the button functions.
